core.headline: Extended family home on 0.3 acres in Sevenoaks
core.summary: A detached house dating from 1968, offering flexible family accommodation across four bedrooms and two receptions, with an extended kitchen/family room, double garage and generous 0.3-acre plot in Sevenoaks.
core.listing:
A detached house dating from 1968, set on a generous 0.3-acre plot in Sevenoaks. The property provides flexible family accommodation across four bedrooms and two bathrooms, with an extended kitchen/family room and double garage. The plot offers scope for gardens and outdoor living, with driveway parking.

The ground floor comprises two reception rooms and the extended kitchen/family room. On the first floor are four bedrooms served by two bathrooms. Gas central heating and mains services are in place.

Outside, the property stands on approximately 0.3 acres with a driveway and double garage. Japanese knotweed was found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025. A herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor is in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee.

The property is located in Sevenoaks TN13.

Guide Price £850,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known. Known issues: Japanese knotweed found in the rear garden near the boundary in 2025; herbicide treatment plan by a PCA-registered contractor in progress, with a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee.
